Rubric.description: The scoring criteria of a task version (ADR 0013). Staff only: it never reaches the candidate API.

RubricCriterion.description: One rubric item, identified within its rubric by a kebab-case string RubricCriterion.Id. Serialised with a `type` discriminator.

RubricCriterionCheckCriterion.description: A Yes / No criterion with an expected answer. A failed critical check is highlighted above the score.

RubricCriterionScaleCriterion.description: A criterion scored 0–4 and weighted in the overall score, with an optional description per level.

ScaleLevel.description: What one score of a ScaleCriterion means.

StaffRole.description: The fixed role of a staff user (ADR 0009, ADR 0020). Sent over the wire by name.
